# Data card - synthetic Body Domain Controller (BDC) HLD dataset

* **Origin:** generated by `Code/scripts/generate_synthetic_hld.py`. All text is original and fictional. No real OEM, supplier or AUTOSAR-consortium document and no copyrighted standards text is included.
* **Files:** `BDC_HLD_v1.0.pdf`, `BDC_HLD_v1.1.pdf` (about 7 pages, 7-8 components, 17-19 ports, 5-6 signals, 8-10 connections, DIDs, requirements, 4 functional flows each).
* **Ground truth (`ground_truth/`):** `truth_kb_v*.json` (entities), `seeded_defects_v*.json` (v1.0: 4, v1.1: 2), `expected_changes_v1.0_to_v1.1.json` (10 changes), `qa_set.json` (31 answerable + 5 out-of-scope), `qa_heldout.json` (15 + 3, written after tuning).
* **Seeded defects:** D1 required port without connection; D2 8-bit signal vs uint16 interface type; D3 reference to undefined SWC_ClimateCtrl; D4 DoorLockStatus vs DoorLockState.
* **Known limits:** clean, single-column text and tables; no diagrams carrying information; no scanned pages; results on this data overstate performance on real HLDs.
* **To use a real HLD:** only with permission and approved status; place the PDF in the UI, check that table headers match `TABLE_TYPES` in `ingest.py`.
